input.quote: 5. PERSONNEL. Each party agrees to assign one (1) existing sales or marketing employee primarily dedicated to assist in the sales and marketing promotional activity set forth in this Exhibit D.
input.rationale: Compliant with the preferred position ("No non-solicit on Customer"): the Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant, so no redline or counterparty comment is proposed. Verification: full-text searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce", "recruit", "entice" and "directly or indirectly" return no restrictive personnel covenant. Section 13 (Shared Resources), which seconds Commerce One operations, consulting and engineering personnel to work alongside Corio staff and is the most likely home for such a covenant, ends at fees, Developments ownership and employee NDA/invention-assignment warranties (p0114, p0116). Section 14 (Miscellaneous) was read in full and covers only assignment, waiver, governing law, notices, independent-contractor status (p0126), severability, force majeure, subcontracting, bankruptcy and integration. The only clause captioned "Personnel" (Exhibit D §5, p0203) merely requires each party to assign a sales/marketing contact and imposes no hiring restriction. The integration clause (p0133) limits incorporation by reference to the Exhibits, the Non Disclosure Agreement and the Statement of Work; those two ancillary documents are not part of this file, so as a residual check we should confirm on the deal record that neither carries a personnel covenant. The failed deterministic checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are parameters of the fallback position and are inapplicable where no restrictive covenant exists. Nothing binds Corio (our client, the licensee/customer) from soliciting or employing Commerce One personnel. Retained as internal evidence only; if Commerce One later proposes a personnel covenant we hold to the fallback (mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire).
